title: Click3R: Interactive Stereo 3D Reconstruction with Sparse Correspondence Clicks
abstract: Despite impressive progress, existing feed-forward large 3D reconstruction models produce a single, irrevocable prediction. When these models fail, there is no mechanism to correct their mistakes. To address this limitation, we introduce Click3R, a framework for interactive geometric correction of feed-forward models using sparse human correspondence clicks. Given an image pair and a small set of cross-view point correspondences provided by a user, Click3R injects geometric constraints into the 3D reconstruction networks through a lightweight point correspondence adapter, enabling the model to resolve ambiguities in challenging scenarios such as repetitive textures, symmetric structures, large viewpoint changes, or textureless regions. To evaluate interactive reconstruction, we curate a challenging benchmark specifically designed to expose failure modes of existing feed-forward 3D reconstruction methods. Experiments show that Click3R reduces reconstruction error with as few as a single correspondence click, improving performance on both standard and our curated benchmarks. Our results highlight that sparse human interaction provides an effective and practical mechanism for correcting geometric reconstruction errors.
tldr: Click3R通过少量跨视图点对应点击交互式修正前馈立体三维重建的几何错误。
motivation: 现有前馈式大规模三维重建模型通常只输出不可修改的单一预测，失败时缺乏纠错机制，尤其在重复纹理、对称结构、大视角变化和无纹理区域等挑战场景中容易产生几何歧义。
method: Click3R利用用户提供的图像对及少量跨视图点对应，通过轻量级点对应适配器将几何约束注入三维重建网络，实现交互式几何校正；同时构建了专门暴露现有前馈方法失败模式的挑战性基准。
result: 实验表明，仅需一次对应点击即可降低重建误差，并在标准基准和所构建的挑战性基准上均取得性能提升。
conclusion: 稀疏人工交互为修正几何重建错误提供了有效且实用的机制，使前馈三维重建模型具备可交互纠错能力，并凸显了交互式重建评测基准的价值。

title: Plant Orbiter: 3D Plant Reconstruction and Generation with Video Diffusion Orbit Cameras and 3D Gaussian Splatting
abstract: Modern digital phenotyping pipelines require the precise measurement of a range of 3D morphological plant traits. The accurate, high throughput acquisition of these traits helps breeders and researchers accelerate the development of new varieties, techniques and products. Recent advances in 3D technologies have enabled a rapid transition from 2D to 3D pipelines, but high throughput acquisition of digital 3D twins of plants remains a significant challenge due to complex morphology, thin structures and occlusions. In this paper we present Plant Orbiter, a new approach to generating 3D plants that leverages recent advances in video diffusion to produce high quality 3D Gaussian Splats of plants from a single image. We show that our method more accurately recreates plant morphology than other state-of-the-art methods, achieving the highest 3D F-score against all baselines, while being more practical for high throughput pipelines due to easier alignment and reduced cost of camera placement. Combined with a 2D diffusion model, we show that our method also achieves state-of-the-art results in the generation of 3D plant models from a text prompt.
tldr: Plant Orbiter 利用视频扩散生成环绕相机，并从单张图像重建高质量植物3D高斯，实现高精度、高通量植物建模。
motivation: 现代数字表型需要精确、高通量地获取植物三维形态性状，以加速育种和新品种开发。但植物形态复杂、结构纤细且遮挡严重，现有从2D到3D流程仍难以高通量获取数字3D孪生。
method: 提出 Plant Orbiter：以视频扩散模型从单张植物图像生成环绕相机轨迹，再用3D Gaussian Splatting重建植物三维高斯表示；结合2D扩散模型，还可由文本提示生成3D植物模型。该方法避免复杂相机布置与对齐，适合高通量流程。
result: 在对比基线中取得最高3D F-score，更准确还原植物形态；因更易对齐且相机布置成本更低，更适合高通量pipeline。与2D扩散结合后，在文本提示生成3D植物模型任务上达到SOTA。
conclusion: 表明视频扩散与3D Gaussian Splatting结合可从单图高效生成高质量植物3D模型，并支持文本到3D生成，为数字表型高通量获取3D植物孪生提供实用方案。

title: Spaghetti Splatting: Differentiating Curvilinear Dirac Masses via Convolution
abstract: In production systems, 3D geometry is represented by primitives such as points, lines, and triangles, as rendering hardware is optimized to generate images from them very efficiently. Learning such primitives from images by volume rendering is challenging, as they are Dirac masses defined at infinitesimal locations in space. EWA splatting, Poisson reconstruction, and 3D Gaussian Splatting overcome this by convolving Dirac masses with a low-frequency kernel, a recipe that generalizes along two axes: the kernel and the primitive. As points and triangles have already received significant attention, we investigate this recipe for curvilinear primitives, and introduce Spaghetti Splatting. We approximate curves by polylines whose convolution converges to that of the continuous curve, and volume render each segment so that connected segments composite without overcounting at their joints. For fast training and inference, we linearize the camera projection per segment, which also accommodates kernels beyond Gaussians, such as Beta kernels. As a point is a curve of zero length, our representation is a strict superset of 3D Gaussian Splatting. It remains competitive with the state-of-the-art on general scenes, outperforms methods specialized to line-like geometry, natively supports anti-aliasing, and produces long connected strands that are directly amenable to physics simulation.
tldr: 提出 Spaghetti Splatting，以折线卷积和逐段体渲染从图像学习曲线基元，兼容 Beta 核并支持抗锯齿。
motivation: 生产系统常用点、线、三角形等基元表示三维几何，但这些基元是空间中的 Dirac 质量，直接通过体渲染从图像学习很困难；现有 EWA splatting、Poisson 重建和 3D Gaussian Splatting 通过低频核卷积缓解该问题，然而曲线基元仍未得到充分研究。
method: 方法用折线近似曲线，使折线卷积收敛到连续曲线卷积；对每段进行体渲染并保证连接处不重复计数，同时逐段线性化相机投影以加速训练与推理，并可适配 Beta 等非高斯核。由于点是零长度曲线，该表示是 3D Gaussian Splatting 的严格超集。
result: 在通用场景上该方法与当前最优方法保持竞争力，在线状几何上优于专用方法，并原生支持抗锯齿；还能生成可直接用于物理模拟的长连接线束。摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: 该工作将 splatting 的“核卷积+基元”思路扩展到曲线基元，提出统一的曲线体渲染框架，增强了线状几何重建、抗锯齿和物理仿真可用性，并可能推动生产级几何基元从图像中学习。

title: V3DSAM: Semantic-Geometric Loop Verification and Geometry-Anchored Persistent Instance Mapping for Feed-Forward Dense SLAM
abstract: To address unreliable cross-view association in long-sequence feed-forward dense SLAM, this letter presents V3DSAM, an open-vocabulary semantic dense SLAM system that establishes physical correspondences at both the scene and object levels. The system combines feed-forward geometric estimates from VGGT-SLAM 2.0 with open-vocabulary semantic observations from SAM3. We introduce semantic-geometric dual-scale loop verification, which identifies false loop closures using pixel-level bidirectional reprojection and object-level 3D spatial correspondences, without accessing backbone-internal features. We further propose geometry-anchored persistent instance mapping, which defines physical instances through class-constrained 3D connectivity in an optimized global coordinate system and assigns global IDs without inter-frame identity propagation. The proposed verifier rejects all four false loop candidates in our TUM RGB-D evaluation, while long-sequence ScanNet experiments show improved instance identity consistency. Thus, V3DSAM reduces dependence on internal backbone features and temporal ID propagation for robust long-term cross-view association.
tldr: V3DSAM结合前馈几何与开放词汇语义，通过双尺度回环验证和几何锚定实例建图提升长期稠密SLAM的跨视图关联可靠性。
motivation: 长序列前馈稠密SLAM中的跨视图关联不可靠，现有方法容易受错误回环闭合和帧间身份传播影响。本文旨在不依赖主干网络内部特征和时间ID传播的情况下，实现稳健的长期场景与物体级物理对应。
method: V3DSAM将VGGT-SLAM 2.0的前馈几何估计与SAM3的开放词汇语义观测相结合。它提出语义-几何双尺度回环验证，利用像素级双向重投影和物体级3D空间对应识别错误回环；并提出几何锚定的持久实例建图，在优化后的全局坐标系中通过类别约束的3D连通性定义物理实例并分配全局ID。
result: 在TUM RGB-D评估中，所提出的验证器拒绝了全部4个错误回环候选；在长序列ScanNet实验中，实例身份一致性得到提升。
conclusion: V3DSAM降低了稳健长期跨视图关联对主干网络内部特征和时序ID传播的依赖，为开放词汇语义稠密SLAM提供了有效的场景级与物体级物理对应方案。

title: Mitigating SM-Level Load Imbalance in 3D Gaussian Splatting on GPUs
abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables photorealistic, real-time rendering on commodity GPUs and is increasingly adopted in generative world models and autonomous driving simulators. However, existing optimizations rely on algorithmic changes that often require retraining, or on specialized accelerators that lack flexibility across evolving 3DGS variants. In this paper, we identify a fundamental inefficiency in GPU-based 3DGS rendering: severe SM-level load imbalance caused by uneven workloads across screen tiles. This imbalance creates a long execution tail, leaving most SMs idle while a few process computationally intensive tiles, particularly in large-scale urban scenes. To address this, we present a software-defined GPU scheduling approach that mitigates the execution tail. Our approach uses a persistent kernel to schedule heavy tiles first and selectively chunks outlier tiles across multiple CTAs. A lightweight per-frame policy determines when and how much to chunk using tile statistics already available in the rendering pipeline. Our approach requires neither retraining nor specialized hardware and can be applied orthogonally to existing optimizations across diverse 3DGS variants. Averaged per scene, it accelerates alpha blending by up to 2.93x on a large-scale urban scene, and by up to 5.6x on its most imbalanced frames, while retaining the original alpha blending formulation.
tldr: 针对3DGS渲染中屏幕瓦片负载不均导致的SM级执行长尾，提出基于持久化内核的软件调度方法，无需重训练即可加速alpha混合。
motivation: 现有3DGS优化多依赖需重训练的算法改动或缺乏灵活性的专用加速器。论文指出GPU渲染中存在严重的SM级负载不均衡：屏幕瓦片工作量不均造成执行长尾，少数SM处理高负载瓦片而多数空闲，在大规模城市场景中尤为突出。
method: 提出软件定义的GPU调度方法，使用持久化内核优先调度重负载瓦片，并选择性地将离群瓦片切分到多个CTA上执行。每帧通过轻量级策略利用渲染管线已有的瓦片统计信息决定何时切分及切分粒度，无需重训练或专用硬件，可与现有3DGS优化正交结合。
result: 按场景平均，在大规模城市场景中将alpha混合加速最高2.93倍；在最不均衡的帧上最高加速5.6倍，同时保留原始alpha混合公式。
conclusion: 该工作将SM级负载不均衡识别为3DGS渲染的关键性能瓶颈，并给出无需重训练、可跨3DGS变体正交部署的软件调度方案，对大规模城市场景实时渲染具有实用价值。

title: EgoLabel: Zero-Shot Egocentric Auto-Labeling with Cross-Modal Consistency
abstract: Egocentric auto-labeling requires depth, camera pose, object, and human-pose estimates to agree across independently developed models. Differences in units, coordinate conventions, and scale can make individually plausible predictions geometrically inconsistent. We present \textbf{EgoLabel}, a zero-shot pipeline that combines off-the-shelf models without target-domain labeled training and provides explicit cross-modal registration and consistency diagnostics. The pipeline integrates MonST3R for geometry, LocateAnything with GMC-BoT-SORT and SAM~2 for objects, and V-HPOT for hands; FisheyeViT provides a separate whole-body compatibility demonstration. Our main hand evaluation uses H2O sensor depth. Across 20 sequences, per-hand depth anchoring reduces the mean of per-sequence median hand--depth residuals by $23\%$ relative to a single global scale, yielding a pooled median of $84.6\,\mathrm{mm}$ against a $20.5\,\mathrm{mm}$ ground-truth reference. Hand PA-MPJPE is $14.53\pm1.29\,\mathrm{mm}$, whereas absolute MPJPE is $119.1\pm31.3\,\mathrm{mm}$, revealing a substantial gap between aligned and metric accuracy. On three RGB-only sequences, camera ATE is $1.40\pm0.29\,\mathrm{cm}$ after $\mathrm{Sim}(3)$ alignment. We also identify a sliding-window implementation issue that allows sensor-initialized depth to change during optimization. Because hand anchoring and its residual share the same depth map, the residual measures internal consistency rather than independent accuracy. These results characterize both the utility and the current limits of the registration pipeline.
tldr: EgoLabel提出零样本第一视角自动标注流水线，通过跨模态配准与一致性诊断整合现成模型。
motivation: 第一视角自动标注需要深度、相机位姿、物体和人体姿态等多个独立模型的结果在几何上一致，但单位、坐标约定和尺度差异会导致单模型看似合理的预测彼此不一致。研究旨在不依赖目标域标注训练的情况下，提供显式跨模态配准与一致性诊断。
method: EgoLabel组合现成模型构建零样本流水线：MonST3R负责几何，LocateAnything结合GMC-BoT-SORT与SAM 2处理物体，V-HPOT处理手部，FisheyeViT用于全身兼容性演示；同时引入跨模态配准、每手深度锚定和一致性残差诊断。
result: 在H2O传感器深度20个序列上，每手深度锚定相较单一全局尺度将每序列手-深度残差中位数的均值降低23%，汇总中位数为84.6 mm，而真值参考为20.5 mm；手部PA-MPJPE为14.53±1.29 mm，绝对MPJPE为119.1±31.3 mm。三个仅RGB序列经Sim(3)对齐后相机ATE为1.40±0.29 cm，并发现滑动窗口实现问题可使传感器初始化深度在优化中改变。
conclusion: 结果表明该配准流水线具有实用价值，但也揭示对齐精度与绝对度量精度之间存在显著差距；由于手部锚定与残差共享同一深度图，残差反映内部一致性而非独立精度，滑动窗口实现问题也限制了当前性能。

title: DPGS-SLAM: Diffusion-Prior and Provenance-Aware Monocular Gaussian Splatting SLAM for Dynamic Visual Sensing
abstract: This paper presents DPGS-SLAM (Diffusion-Prior and Provenance-Aware Monocular Gaussian Splatting SLAM) for dense mapping in environments containing dynamic objects. Dynamic observations can contaminate camera tracking and scene reconstruction in visual SLAM (simultaneous localization and mapping). Although 3DGS (3D Gaussian splatting) enables efficient dense mapping, existing 3DGS-SLAM systems may exhibit instability when dynamic objects violate their underlying static-scene assumption. Excluding dynamic observations can reduce their influence on tracking and mapping, but may leave occluded static backgrounds missing or weakly constrained. Our proposed DPGS-SLAM is a monocular RGB SLAM framework that supports provisional representations of insufficiently observed static backgrounds through asynchronous diffusion-based background completion and provenance-aware Gaussian mapping. Dynamic regions are identified through optical-flow-based motion discovery and temporally consistent mask propagation by SAM2 (segment anything model 2). For selected keyframes, a fine-tuned diffusion inpainting model generates plausible background appearance in occluded regions, while Metric3D v2 predicts metric depth from the completed images to initialize provisional Gaussian primitives. Provenance labels distinguish generated primitives from observation-supported primitives, excluding generated content from camera-pose estimation and observed-map optimization. When previously occluded backgrounds become visible, eligible generated primitives are removed, and observation-supported primitives are independently initialized from real RGB observations and predicted depth. Experimental results demonstrated competitive camera tracking, with average ATE RMSE values of 1.2 cm on TUM RGB-D and 2.7 cm on BONN RGB-D. On StaDy4D, DPGS-SLAM improved average PSNR by 4.60 dB over WildGS-SLAM using only monocular RGB input.
tldr: DPGS-SLAM利用扩散补全与来源感知高斯建图，在动态单目RGB场景中实现鲁棒跟踪与稠密重建。
motivation: 动态物体会污染视觉SLAM的相机跟踪与场景重建，现有3DGS-SLAM在动态场景下违背静态假设而变得不稳定；直接剔除动态观测又会导致被遮挡的静态背景缺失或约束不足。
method: DPGS-SLAM通过光流运动发现与SAM2时序一致掩码传播识别动态区域，对选定关键帧使用微调扩散修复模型补全背景，并由Metric3D v2预测度量深度以初始化临时高斯基元；来源标签区分生成基元与观测支持基元，生成内容不参与相机位姿估计和观测地图优化，待背景可见后移除符合条件的生成基元并用真实RGB观测重新初始化观测支持基元。
result: 实验表明该方法具有竞争力的相机跟踪精度，在TUM RGB-D和BONN RGB-D上的平均ATE RMSE分别为1.2 cm和2.7 cm；在StaDy4D上仅用单目RGB输入，平均PSNR比WildGS-SLAM提升4.60 dB。
conclusion: DPGS-SLAM为观测不足的静态背景提供临时表示，并结合扩散先验与来源感知高斯建图提升动态单目SLAM的跟踪与稠密重建鲁棒性，对动态视觉感知场景具有应用潜力。

title: HIST3R: Decomposing and Rectifying State Updates with History for Streaming 3D Reconstruction
abstract: Streaming 3D reconstruction with recurrent states enables long-video scene understanding under bounded memory, but turns reconstruction into a state-evolution problem: each incoming frame updates a compact scene memory on which all subsequent predictions depend, so unreliable updates overwrite historical context and accumulate into long-horizon geometric drift. We analyze CUT3R-style recurrent updates through a direction--magnitude decomposition, in which the magnitude sets the update gain, i.e., how strongly an observation is written into the state, and the direction encodes the geometric intent, i.e., where the update drives the state. This decomposition provides a unified view of CUT3R and its variants, revealing that existing training-free extensions perform magnitude-only control: they can attenuate an unreliable update but cannot correct its direction. We propose HIST3R, a training-free framework built on CUT3R that controls both components using history. HIST3R rectifies the update direction using locally consistent historical states, and modulates the update magnitude according to the visual discrepancy between the current observation and its history, suppressing redundant updates while preserving complementary evidence. Across camera pose estimation, 3D reconstruction, and video depth estimation, HIST3R consistently improves long-horizon performance while retaining the memory footprint and inference speed of CUT3R. With 1000 input frames, it reduces ATE by 23.87% on ScanNet and 33.65% on TUM-Dynamics relative to the strongest competing method; with 500 frames, it improves median reconstruction accuracy over the strongest CUT3R-based variant by 56.52% on 7-Scenes and 33.96% on NRGBD.
tldr: HIST3R用历史状态校正循环状态更新的方向与幅度，无需训练即可抑制长时序几何漂移。
motivation: 流式三维重建中，每帧都会更新一个紧凑的循环场景记忆，后续所有预测都依赖该记忆；不可靠的更新会覆盖历史上下文，误差随帧数累积形成长时序几何漂移。作者指出，现有CUT3R的无训练扩展只做幅度控制，即仅衰减不可靠更新，而无法纠正其方向，因此漂移问题得不到根本解决。
method: 作者将CUT3R式循环更新分解为方向与幅度两部分：幅度决定更新增益，即观测写入状态的强度；方向编码几何意图，即更新把状态推向何处。基于这一统一视角，提出无需训练的HIST3R框架：利用局部一致的历史状态校正更新的方向；同时根据当前观测与其历史之间的视觉差异调制更新的幅度，从而抑制冗余更新，并保留互补信息。
result: 在相机位姿估计、三维重建和视频深度估计任务上，HIST3R均提升了长时序性能，同时保持与CUT3R相同的内存占用和推理速度。输入1000帧时，ATE在ScanNet上比最强对比方法降低23.87%，在TUM-Dynamics上降低33.65%；输入500帧时，中位重建精度在7-Scenes上比最强CUT3R类变体提升56.52%，在NRGBD上提升33.96%。
conclusion: 该工作表明，方向与幅度分解为理解和改进循环式流式重建提供了统一视角；同时证明仅靠历史信息即可在不增加训练成本、不牺牲效率的前提下同时校正更新方向与幅度，显著缓解长时序漂移，对有限内存下的长视频三维感知具有实用价值。

title: 3R-Adapter: Retrieval, Rewiring, and Refinement for Efficient Adaptation of 3D Reconstruction Model
abstract: Feed-forward 3D reconstruction models have demonstrated strong generalization under large-scale pre-training, yet they struggle in long-tail scenarios such as low-light reconstruction, joint human-scene reconstruction, and test-time adaptation. We observe relational attention structure collapse, manifested as the failure of cross-view correspondences, as a primary cause of these limitations. While adaptation offers a practical way to bridge this gap, existing parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) approaches mainly perform channel-wise feature adjustment and lack mechanisms to explicitly adapt relational structures, leaving correspondence failures unresolved. In this work, we formulate adaptation of 3D reconstruction models as a problem of correspondence recovery under domain shift and propose 3R-Adapter, a PEFT paradigm for long-tail 3D reconstruction scenarios. Our method consists of three components: Deformable Retrieval for task-adaptive relation candidate retrieval, Relational Rewiring for reconstructing cross-view relational structures, and Consistency Refinement for injecting the rewired relations into stable predictions. Extensive experiments on low-light reconstruction, joint human-scene reconstruction, and test-time adaptation demonstrate that our approach significantly improves robustness over existing PEFT methods while maintaining efficient lightweight adaptation. Our code is released at https://github.com/PKU-OV3-LAB/3R-Adapter.
tldr: 提出3R-Adapter，通过关系检索、重连与一致性精炼恢复跨视图对应，实现3D重建模型高效长尾自适应。
motivation: 前馈3D重建模型在大规模预训练下泛化较强，但在低光照重建、人体-场景联合重建和测试时自适应等长尾场景中表现不佳。作者观察到关系注意力结构坍塌导致跨视图对应失败，而现有PEFT方法主要做通道级特征调整，缺乏对关系结构的显式适配机制。
method: 将域偏移下的3D重建模型适配建模为对应关系恢复问题，提出PEFT范式3R-Adapter。其包含三部分：Deformable Retrieval进行任务自适应关系候选检索，Relational Rewiring重建跨视图关系结构，Consistency Refinement将重连关系注入稳定预测。
result: 在低光照重建、人体-场景联合重建和测试时自适应实验中，3R-Adapter相比现有PEFT方法显著提升鲁棒性，同时保持轻量高效适配；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: 3R-Adapter通过显式恢复跨视图关系结构，为长尾3D重建场景提供高效PEFT方案，缓解关系注意力结构坍塌与对应失败问题，并已开源代码。

title: UltraVoxelGS: Voxel-First Feed-Forward Gaussian Splatting for 3D Ultrasound Reconstruction
abstract: We present UltraVoxelGS, a 3D ultrasound reconstruction method that achieves both fast reconstruction and physically faithful rendering for the first time, bringing live spatial feedback during 2D ultrasound scanning within reach. This is made possible by a feed-forward design that predicts a complete Gaussian scene representation from posed ultrasound images directly, entirely bypassing the per-scene optimization bottleneck that has confined prior methods to offline use. Realising such feed-forward prediction in this setting is non-trivial: unlike natural images, ultrasound slices share at most one-dimensional intersections and exhibit view-dependent appearance due to acoustic propagation and attenuation, violating the dense overlap and photometric consistency assumed by existing feed-forward Gaussian methods. Hence, to achieve fast reconstruction, we introduce a feed-forward voxel-to-Gaussian pass that decouples representation size from input count by lifting all posed slices into a fixed-size voxel support and predicting Gaussian parameters directly. For faithful rendering, we propose ultrasound-aware appearance rendering strategy factorize reflection from cumulative attenuation during training and exploit appearance continuity among spatially adjacent slices for efficient Render-time Appearance Adaptation. On both real-world and simulated datasets, UltraVoxelGS achieves best PSNR/SSIM compared with per-scene optimization baselines while reducing inference from 10-20 minutes to approximately 10 seconds (over 35 times faster) and scales to sequences exceeding 1,000 frames. Code is available at https://github.com/YuebyYue/UltraVoxelGS-camera-ready.
tldr: 提出前馈体素到高斯的3D超声重建，约10秒完成且渲染物理保真。
motivation: 现有3D超声重建依赖逐场景优化，需10-20分钟，只能离线使用。自然图像的前馈高斯方法假设稠密重叠与光度一致性，但超声切片最多一维相交，且因声传播与衰减呈现视角相关外观，无法直接适用。
method: 提出前馈体素到高斯通路，将所有带位姿切片提升到固定尺寸体素支撑并直接预测高斯参数，使表示规模与输入帧数解耦。训练时分解反射与累积衰减实现超声感知外观渲染，并利用空间相邻切片的外观连续性进行渲染时外观自适应。
result: 在真实与仿真数据集上，PSNR/SSIM优于逐场景优化基线；推理时间从10-20分钟降至约10秒（超过35倍加速），并可扩展到超过1000帧的序列。
conclusion: 首次同时实现快速重建与物理保真渲染，有望为2D超声扫描提供实时空间反馈，推动前馈高斯泼溅在医学超声中的应用，代码已开源。

title: Watching Itself Watch: Self-Auditing Visual Reliance for Video Reasoning
abstract: Video reasoning hinges on a small number of visually decisive tokens embedded in otherwise largely language-driven chains of thought. Yet prevailing post-training methods such as GRPO overlook this structure, assigning coarse trajectory-level rewards while requiring multiple rollouts and often costly external judges. We introduce Visually-Aware On-Policy Self-Distillation (VIOS), a post-training framework that identifies where a model under-utilizes visual evidence and concentrates learning at those positions. Our key insight is that a model can audit its own visual reliance: the divergence between its next-token distributions with and without the video reveals how strongly each prediction depends on the visual input. Measuring this reliance for both a student and an answer-privileged teacher exposes a per-token reliance gap, identifying positions where the teacher exploits visual evidence that the student overlooks. VIOS translates this signal into dense, targeted supervision through three complementary components: an exponential moving average (EMA) teacher that co-evolves with the student, a contrastive objective that encourages predictions to depend on the video, and a reliance-gap gate that focuses learning on visually under-utilized tokens. Crucially, VIOS requires only a single on-policy rollout from a single model, without external rewards, judges, or larger teachers. Across 12 benchmarks spanning general, temporal, spatial, knowledge-intensive, and long-video understanding, VIOS consistently improves three model backbones and outperforms contemporary video-reasoning systems, while training in over 9x fewer steps, 60x fewer FLOPs, and 111x fewer generated tokens. Project page: https://vision.cs.utexas.edu/projects/VIOS/
tldr: VIOS通过自审计视觉依赖，在单次on-policy rollout中对视觉欠利用token施加密集监督，高效提升视频推理。
motivation: 现有GRPO等视频推理后训练方法采用粗粒度轨迹级奖励，忽视语言主导思维链中少数视觉决定性token，且依赖多次rollout和昂贵外部评判。VIOS旨在定位模型未充分利用视觉证据的位置，并施加更密集、更有针对性的监督。
method: VIOS让模型比较有视频与无视频时下一token分布的差异，以量化逐token视觉依赖；再比较学生模型与答案特权教师模型的依赖差，得到reliance gap。框架结合与学生共同进化的EMA教师、鼓励预测依赖视频的对比目标，以及聚焦视觉欠利用token的reliance-gap门控，仅需单模型单次on-policy rollout，无需外部奖励、评判器或更大教师。
result: 在覆盖通用、时序、空间、知识密集和长视频理解的12个基准上，VIOS稳定提升三种模型骨干并优于当代视频推理系统；训练步数减少9倍以上、FLOPs减少60倍、生成token减少111倍。
conclusion: VIOS将自审计的逐token视觉依赖转化为密集监督，在无外部奖励和评判器条件下高效提升视频推理能力，并大幅降低训练计算与采样成本，为视频推理后训练提供了可扩展的新范式。

title: Scale-Consistent Monocular Fisheye Visual Odometry via Spherical Bundle Adjustment-Guided Unsupervised Depth Learning
abstract: The wide field of view of fisheye cameras and the simplicity of a monocular setup make monocular fisheye visual odometry (VO) attractive for robotic localization and mapping. Nevertheless, scale drift remains a major challenge over long trajectories. Unsupervised depth learning can help to mitigate this issue, but the pronounced distortion of fisheye images poses challenges for accurate depth estimation. This article presents S$^2$D-FVO, a monocular fisheye VO framework integrating spherical bundle adjustment (SBA)-guided unsupervised depth learning to improve scale consistency and depth estimation accuracy. Given that pixel reprojection residuals do not uniformly reflect angular deviations between viewing rays and that the first-order linearization of a scalar angular reprojection residual is insensitive to perturbations along one tangent direction, SBA employs tangent-space angular reprojection residuals derived from the spherical logarithmic map. These residuals retain sensitivity along both tangent directions, with their norms equal to the corresponding scalar angular residuals. A median depth-based scale regularization term is further integrated into SBA to constrain the reconstruction scale. Building on these formulations, SBA replaces the pose estimation network during unsupervised depth learning, providing more reliable relative poses for view synthesis. In turn, depth estimates from the well-trained depth estimation network provide scale references for SBA, improving scale consistency while allowing individual 3-D landmark positions to be refined. Extensive experiments conducted on multiple public datasets, as well as two newly collected large-scale datasets, demonstrate that the proposed framework outperforms representative existing approaches in both depth and trajectory estimation accuracy and is applicable to different camera models.
tldr: 提出S²D-FVO，用球面光束法平差引导无监督深度学习，提升鱼眼单目视觉里程计的尺度一致性与深度精度。
motivation: 鱼眼相机视野宽且单目配置简单，使单目鱼眼视觉里程计适合机器人定位与建图，但长轨迹上尺度漂移仍是主要挑战。无监督深度学习可缓解该问题，然而鱼眼图像显著畸变会影响深度估计准确性。
method: 提出S²D-FVO框架，将球面光束法平差（SBA）与无监督深度学习结合：SBA采用基于球面对数映射的切空间角度重投影残差，使其在两个切方向上均保持敏感性，并加入基于中值深度的尺度正则项约束重建尺度。SBA在无监督深度学习中替代位姿估计网络，为视图合成提供更可靠相对位姿；训练好的深度网络反过来为SBA提供尺度参考，提升尺度一致性并细化三维路标位置。
result: 在多个公开数据集以及两个新采集的大规模数据集上，该框架在深度估计和轨迹估计精度上均优于代表性现有方法，并适用于不同相机模型；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: 该工作表明，将球面光束法平差与无监督深度学习结合可有效改善单目鱼眼视觉里程计的尺度一致性和深度估计精度，并具备跨相机模型的适用性，对机器人定位与建图具有潜在价值。

title: ACROSSVAM3.0: Resource-Bounded 4D Scene Construction and Adaptive Surface Association
abstract: Combining video generation, dynamic reconstruction and monocular SLAM requires consistent coordinates, explicit handling of missing outputs and predictable memory use. We present AcrossVAM3.0, an offline system that converts text, images or monocular RGB video into a versioned point representation. Frozen components run sequentially on one GPU; map corrections update cameras, points and trajectories together. The coordination layer adds no neural parameters. Three fresh input-mode runs completed with a maximum sampled task-process-tree GPU footprint of 17.14 GB. In a frozen 16-scene video suite, every scene yielded a 4D reconstruction and 15 yielded a non-empty SLAM map. Strict cross-window matching reduced local surface error but lost long-range track coverage on TAP-Vid-DAVIS. We therefore developed multi-hypothesis adaptive surface chaining (MHAC), which retains several candidate matches and an explicit missing state. After selection on disjoint development data, MHAC improved Average Jaccard over a position-only baseline by 0.1394 on a frozen ten-video holdout (95% bootstrap interval [0.1074,0.1689]). Across 265 RoboTAP videos, the mean paired gain was 0.0610 ([0.0510,0.0715]), with 215 wins, one tie and 49 losses. These results support resource-bounded scene construction and an external tracking gain under the tested protocol. They do not establish metric scale, semantic identity or high-fidelity novel-view rendering.
tldr: AcrossVAM3.0 在单 GPU 资源约束下将文本、图像或单目视频转为版本化点表示，并联合校正相机、点与轨迹。
motivation: 研究旨在统一视频生成、动态重建与单目 SLAM，解决多组件组合时坐标不一致、输出缺失需显式处理以及内存开销不可预测的问题。
method: 系统离线运行冻结组件于单 GPU，协调层不含神经参数，将文本、图像或单目 RGB 视频转换为版本化点表示，并在建图修正时同步更新相机、点和轨迹。针对跨窗口匹配覆盖不足，提出多假设自适应表面链接 MHAC，保留多个候选匹配及显式缺失状态。
result: 三次新输入模式运行的最大采样任务进程树 GPU 占用为 17.14 GB；16 场景视频套件均完成 4D 重建，15 个得到非空 SLAM 地图。冻结十视频留出集上 MHAC 较仅位置基线将 Average Jaccard 提升 0.1394（95% bootstrap 区间 [0.1074,0.1689]），RoboTAP 265 视频平均配对增益 0.0610（[0.0510,0.0715]），215 胜 1 平 49 负。
conclusion: 结果表明在测试协议下可实现资源受限的场景构建并获得外部跟踪增益，但未建立度量尺度、语义身份或高保真新视角渲染能力。

title: Budget-aware Correspondence-driven View Selection for Real-time 3D Perception of Mobile Robots
abstract: 3D visual perception and scene reconstruction are critical for autonomous robots and intelligent transportation, yet real-world deployments often generate long, redundant image sequences that hinder downstream processing. This report investigates BCVS (budget-aware correspondence-driven view sampling), a pose-free view selection algorithm that offers 22+ FPS on a CPU, enabling online filtering for efficient 3D perception by mobile robots. Unlike existing approaches that rely on full structure-from-motion (SfM) pipelines or camera pose estimation, BCVS employs a purely correspondence-based scoring strategy that prioritizes view novelty while maintaining sufficient overlap for geometric stability. Given a user-specified budget, BCVS iteratively selects the most distinct frames and suppresses near-duplicates, producing compact subsets that preserve connectivity and minimize reconstruction loss. Extensive experiments on benchmark show that BCVS outperforms CPU-friendly baselines at tight budgets and remains competitive as budgets scale. Field trials with large aerial and marine robotics data further validate its practicality and scalability: BCVS reduces redundancy up to 16% while sustaining robust SfM registration and high-quality 3D reconstructions.
tldr: BCVS是一种无需位姿的预算感知视图选择算法，可在CPU上以22+ FPS在线过滤冗余图像并保持三维重建质量。
motivation: 真实机器人部署常产生长且冗余的图像序列，严重阻碍下游三维感知与重建处理；现有方法多依赖完整SfM流程或相机位姿估计，计算成本高，难以满足移动机器人实时在线过滤需求。
method: BCVS采用纯对应关系驱动的评分策略，无需相机位姿或完整SfM，在用户给定预算下迭代选择最具新颖性的帧并抑制近重复帧，同时保持足够重叠以维持几何连通性和重建稳定性。
result: 在基准实验中，BCVS在紧预算下优于CPU友好基线，并随预算扩大保持竞争力；在大型航空与海洋机器人现场数据中，冗余最高降低16%，同时维持稳健的SfM配准和高质量三维重建，并在CPU上达到22+ FPS。
conclusion: BCVS提供了一种实用、可扩展的在线视图选择方案，其无需位姿、预算感知和对应关系驱动的特点有助于移动机器人高效三维感知与重建，并具备在真实大规模场景中部署的潜力。

title: Towards Rotation-Only Imaging Geometry: Multi-View Pose Estimation
abstract: Global structure-from-motion (SfM) commonly refines relative poses on individual image pairs and then estimates global rotations by rotation averaging. Pairwise refinement does not explicitly combine feature-level constraints with multi-view consistency during rotation initialization. We introduce Global Rotations from Aggregated Matches (GRAM), which estimates global rotations directly from initial relative rotations and inlier matches by minimizing edge-wise rotation-only algebraic residuals. GRAM replaces two-view relative-pose optimization and rotation averaging with a single stage. We further extend rotation- only imaging geometry to multiple views and develop Multi-view Optimization with Rotation-only Reprojection Error (MORE) for nonlinear global rotation refinement. Analytical Rotation-guided Translation (ART) derives locally scaled triplet translations from Linear Global Translation (LiGT) constraints and recovers global translations using weighted least squares. Synthetic and real-world experiments demonstrate the accuracy, robustness, and efficiency of the proposed methods.
tldr: 提出GRAM、MORE和ART，以单阶段全局旋转估计替代两视图优化与旋转平均，并扩展到多视图旋转几何和平移恢复。
motivation: 全局SfM通常先对图像对做相对位姿细化，再做旋转平均，未能在旋转初始化阶段显式结合特征级约束与多视图一致性。本文旨在直接用初始相对旋转和内点匹配估计全局旋转，并统一多视图旋转几何与平移恢复。
method: GRAM通过最小化边级旋转-only代数残差，从初始相对旋转和内点匹配直接估计全局旋转，将两视图相对位姿优化与旋转平均合并为单阶段。MORE将旋转-only成像几何扩展到多视图，利用旋转-only重投影误差进行非线性全局旋转精化；ART基于LiGT约束从三元组推导局部尺度平移，并用加权最小二乘恢复全局平移。
result: 摘要未提供具体量化指标；合成与真实世界实验表明，所提方法在精度、鲁棒性和效率方面具有优势。
conclusion: 本文将全局旋转初始化与非线性精化统一到旋转-only几何框架，并将旋转引导用于平移恢复，为全局SfM提供了更紧凑的位姿估计流程；实验验证了其精度、鲁棒性与效率。

title: Feel My Focus: Gaze-Triggered Digital Twin Creation for Remote Collaboration
abstract: We present Feel My Focus, a gaze-triggered mixed reality (MR) demonstration that enables rapid creation and sharing of lightweight 3D digital twins during remote collaboration. Unlike systems that use gaze primarily as a referential pointer, Feel My Focus treats sustained visual attention as a generative action: a fixation on a physical object initiates single-image capture, attention-guided segmentation, and one-shot 3D reconstruction, allowing a remote partner to inspect and discuss the object in situ. The system integrates gaze-tracking glasses, modular segmentation and reconstruction services, and an MR client for runtime streaming and interaction. This design prioritizes responsiveness and experiential continuity over photometric fidelity. We report observations from a public demonstration, highlighting design trade-offs, failure modes, and user control considerations for deploying gaze-triggered generative systems in real-world collaborative settings.
tldr: 系统以持续注视触发单图分割与单样本三维重建，快速生成可共享的轻量数字孪生以支持远程协作。
motivation: 远程协作需要快速创建并共享物理对象的轻量3D表示；现有系统多将凝视作为指向工具，而该工作把持续视觉注意视为生成动作，并优先保证响应性与体验连续性而非光度保真。
method: 集成凝视追踪眼镜、模块化分割与重建服务以及MR客户端进行运行时流式传输和交互；当用户注视物理对象时，触发单图像捕获、注意力引导分割和one-shot 3D重建，使远程伙伴能够原位查看并讨论该对象。
result: 摘要报告了公开演示中的观察，重点讨论设计权衡、失败模式和用户控制考虑，未提供量化实验结果或性能指标。
conclusion: 该工作展示了凝视触发式生成数字孪生在真实远程协作场景中的可行性，贡献在于将持续注视转化为生成式交互范式，并总结了部署此类MR协作系统的经验与潜在影响。

title: Martine: Benchmarking Multi-View 3D Surface Reconstruction Across Viewpoint Coverage, Resolution, and Lighting
abstract: Controlled acquisition setups are widely used for high-accuracy multi-view 3D surface reconstruction, as they allow sensor configuration, image resolution, viewpoint distribution, and illumination to be specified. Yet benchmarking remains difficult, since reconstruction accuracy depends jointly on the reconstruction paradigm, object properties, and acquisition regime. Existing benchmarks often restrict viewpoint coverage, resolution, or illumination, which can bias comparisons towards methods suited to the chosen setting. Others lack accurate 3D ground truth or quantified image-to-geometry alignment, limiting their use for metric surface evaluation. We introduce Martine, a benchmark for controlled 3D object surface reconstruction. Martine comprises 28 objects, including transparent materials and fine structures, captured at 9568 x 6376 pixels from 84 views over a spherical cap under both single-light and multi-light regimes. It provides object-independent camera calibration, accurate 3D ground-truth scans, calibration and image-to-geometry accuracy quantified on test images, and 3D property masks for analysing errors by material properties, visibility, curvature and fine structures. Experiments across photogrammetry, classical multi-view stereo, neural implicit surfaces, Gaussian-splatting-based reconstruction, and multi-view photometric stereo show that Martine enables regime-aware evaluation with explicit control over reference-data accuracy. The benchmark resolves sub-millimetric reconstruction differences, with a best observed Chamfer distance of 0.058 mm over the evaluated visible surface.
tldr: Martine 是受控多视角三维表面重建基准，覆盖视角、分辨率与光照变化。
motivation: 现有基准常限制视角覆盖、分辨率或光照，导致比较偏向特定采集条件的方法；部分基准缺乏精确三维真值或量化的图像到几何对齐，难以进行度量表面评估。Martine 旨在提供可控采集条件下的公平、工况感知重建评测。
method: 构建包含28个物体（含透明材质与精细结构）的数据集，在球冠上以84视角、9568×6376分辨率、单光源和多光源条件采集；提供物体无关相机标定、精确三维真值扫描、测试图像上的标定与图像到几何精度量化，以及按材质属性、可见性、曲率和精细结构分析误差的三维属性掩码。评测覆盖摄影测量、经典多视图立体、神经隐式表面、基于Gaussian-splatting的重建和多视图光度立体。
result: 在可见表面上最佳Chamfer距离为0.058 mm，并可分辨亚毫米级重建差异；跨多种范式实验表明该基准支持对参考数据精度进行显式控制的工况感知评测。
conclusion: Martine 提供了高分辨率、多光照、带精确真值和属性掩码的受控多视角表面重建基准，支持按采集工况与物体属性进行公平比较和误差分析。其贡献在于提升基准的可控性与度量可靠性，并可能推动透明物体、精细结构等困难场景的重建研究。

title: FastGRT: Accelerating Training of 3D Gaussian Ray Tracing
abstract: Ray Tracing enables rendering capabilities that are difficult to achieve with rasterization-based approaches such as 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS). However, the training cost of Gaussian-based ray tracing (GRT) is much higher than that of 3DGS. In this paper, we study how ray tracing using Gaussians executes on GPUs and show that a considerable fraction of the training cost arises from how the computation is organized. We develop FastGRT, which decouples ray traversal from blending and reuses work done in the forward pass for the backward pass. FastGRT further incorporates optimizations such as fast gradient accumulation and a hybrid BVH update strategy to tackle other major bottlenecks in the training pipeline. We implement FastGRT in Vulkan. To the best of our knowledge, it is the first Vulkan-based GRT implementation that supports both training and rendering. Compared to 3DGRT, FastGRT improves training time by 1.9$\times$ to 4.97$\times$, while preserving the original rendering formulation. Our code is open source.
tldr: FastGRT通过解耦光线遍历与混合并复用前向计算，将高斯光线追踪训练加速1.9至4.97倍。
motivation: 光线追踪能实现基于光栅化的3D Gaussian Splatting难以达到的渲染效果，但基于高斯的光线追踪训练成本远高于3DGS。作者分析GPU上高斯光线追踪的执行过程，发现相当一部分训练开销源于计算的组织方式。
method: FastGRT将光线遍历与混合过程解耦，并在反向传播中复用前向传播已完成的工作；同时引入快速梯度累积和混合BVH更新策略以缓解训练流水线中的其他瓶颈。该方法在Vulkan中实现，是首个同时支持训练与渲染的Vulkan版GRT实现，并保持原始渲染公式不变。
result: 与3DGRT相比，FastGRT将训练时间缩短为原来的1/1.9至1/4.97，即实现1.9倍到4.97倍的训练加速，同时保持原始渲染公式不变。代码已开源。
conclusion: FastGRT表明通过优化计算组织方式可显著降低高斯光线追踪的训练开销，其Vulkan开源实现同时支持训练与渲染，有助于推动高斯光线追踪训练的实用化。

title: TransArt3D: From Two States to Articulated 3D Reconstruction with Video Transition Priors
abstract: Reconstructing interactable articulated assets from a few images is key to robotics and simulation, yet highly underconstrained. Existing optimization-based methods fit an articulated asset under a static 3D prior that scores each state independently, so per-state reconstruction errors leak into the estimated moving part and joint as false motion. Video diffusion models capture how objects move between states, but only implicitly in 2D. To this end, we present TransArt3D, an optimization-based framework that reconstructs an articulated 3D asset from two endpoint images by translating this video transition prior into explicit part structure and joint kinematics. It first lifts frames generated between the endpoints with a transition-coupled 3D consensus that applies the static 3D prior jointly across frames, stabilizing unchanging regions and initializing the parts and joint. A rectified-flow kinematic refinement then lets the video prior supervise a 3D motion field over the whole transition, while part assignment and a shared joint constrain the field throughout optimization, keeping per-state errors out of the articulation. Finally, a motion-aware canonical appearance fusion uses the recovered articulation to map both endpoint images onto one canonical surface, texturing regions that only one state reveals. On PartNet-Mobility, TransArt3D outperforms methods given the same two endpoints in geometry and joint accuracy, and surpasses methods given six observed states in articulated-state geometry, joint localization and appearance.
tldr: TransArt3D利用视频过渡先验从两帧图像重建关节化3D资产，并提升几何、关节与外观精度。
motivation: 从少量图像重建可交互关节化资产高度欠约束。现有优化方法在静态3D先验下独立评估每个状态，单状态重建误差会泄漏到运动部件和关节，形成虚假运动；视频扩散模型虽隐含物体运动，但仅限2D。
method: 提出TransArt3D优化框架，将两端点间的视频过渡先验转化为显式部件结构与关节运动学。先用过渡耦合的3D共识联合多帧应用静态3D先验，稳定不变区域并初始化部件与关节；再用rectified-flow运动学细化，让视频先验监督整个过渡的3D运动场，并以部件分配和共享关节约束优化；最后用运动感知的规范外观融合将两端点图像映射到统一规范表面进行纹理补全。
result: 在PartNet-Mobility上，TransArt3D在相同两端点输入下几何和关节精度优于对比方法，并在关节状态几何、关节定位和外观上超过使用六个观测状态的方法。
conclusion: TransArt3D证明可将2D视频过渡先验显式用于关节化3D重建，减少单状态误差对关节估计的干扰，并提升少视角下的几何、运动学与外观质量，对机器人和仿真资产生成有潜在价值。

title: Map2SLAM: From Streaming Map Prediction to Real-Time SLAM
abstract: Streaming 3D foundation models (3DFMs) estimate camera poses and dense geometry online, but they fall short of SLAM: their predictions are fixed once emitted, so loop closures cannot correct accumulated drift. With such models already providing strong geometric capability, a central question for SLAM becomes how to schedule their inference and how to keep its results as revisable state. We present Map2SLAM, which keeps LingBot-Map frozen, trains only a lightweight retrieval head, and builds SLAM on the model's inference interface, turning its predictions into observations of an external persistent SLAM state. The front-end tracks every incoming frame with the model's causal streaming inference and decides which frames are written to the persistent state as keyframes. The back-end asynchronously decides when and which past frames to re-observe, re-running the model's joint inference over them with fresh context; verified loop observations correct the trajectory online, and segment observations refine dense geometry after the sequence. All invocations share a single frame encoder pass per image, whose cached features also drive loop retrieval, so frequent re-invocation incurs no additional encoding cost. Map2SLAM achieves state-of-the-art performance on KITTI, VBR, and Oxford Spires, reducing mean ATE by over 40% compared with the best uncalibrated baselines, while maintaining real-time tracking at over 28 FPS at a resolution of $518\times154$ on an NVIDIA RTX 5090D GPU. Please visit our project page at https://robbyant-research.github.io/Map2SLAM/.
tldr: 将冻结的流式3D基础模型输出转为外部可修正SLAM状态的观测，实现实时可回环的SLAM。
motivation: 流式3D基础模型（3DFM）可在线估计相机位姿与稠密几何，但其预测一经输出便固定，无法通过回环闭合修正累积漂移，因而不足以构成完整SLAM。论文因此提出核心问题：如何调度这类模型的推理，并使其结果保持为可修正的状态。
method: 保持LingBot-Map冻结，仅训练轻量检索头，在模型推理接口之上构建SLAM：前端用因果流式推理跟踪每帧并决定哪些帧作为关键帧写入外部持久SLAM状态；后端异步决定何时、对哪些历史帧重新观测，以新上下文重跑模型的联合推理，验证后的回环观测在线校正轨迹，分段观测在序列结束后精化稠密几何。所有调用共享每图单次编码器前向，缓存特征同时用于回环检索，故频繁重调用不增加编码开销。
result: 在KITTI、VBR与Oxford Spires上取得state-of-the-art，相比最佳未标定基线平均ATE降低超过40%，并在NVIDIA RTX 5090D上以518×154分辨率保持超过28 FPS的实时跟踪。
conclusion: 结果表明，将流式3DFM的预测视为可被反复重观测的外部持久状态观测，即可把其强几何能力转化为具备回环修正能力的实时SLAM系统；其推理调度与可修正状态设计对后续基于基础模型的SLAM具有借鉴意义。

title: PLS-GS: Probabilistic Lidar Scaffolds for Compact, Surface-Aligned Gaussian Splatting
abstract: While 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) is typically optimized from images only, many robotics and mapping applications provide both camera and high-definition LiDAR data, combining rich visual appearance with accurate geometric structure. We introduce PLS-GS, a probabilistic LiDAR scaffold for Gaussian Splatting that exploits this complementary sensing setting to construct a compact 3DGS representation aligned to the measured surface. PLS-GS fits a Hierarchical Gaussian Mixture Model jointly over position and color, yielding a continuous and adaptive scaffold that eliminates the need for discrete scene partitioning such as voxel grids or octrees. The fitted mixture then guides the renderable 3DGS Gaussians: each rendering Gaussian is associated with a GMM component and constrained in the local surface frame induced by that component's covariance. A Mahalanobis support loss bounds the deviation of the rendering Gaussians from the corresponding LiDAR-derived surface. Across five large outdoor scenes, PLS-GS places primitives markedly closer to the LiDAR measurements than both image- and LiDAR-initialized baselines, while employing substantially fewer primitives, yielding a considerably more compact model and faster rendering. At matched capacity, PLS-GS places primitives closer to the LiDAR measurements, with comparable rendering quality. Code is available at https://github.com/k-harikumar/PLS-GS.
tldr: PLS-GS利用概率LiDAR支架将3D高斯对齐到测量表面，实现紧凑且更快的渲染。
motivation: 3DGS通常仅从图像优化，而机器人与建图场景常同时提供相机和高精度LiDAR数据。PLS-GS旨在利用这种互补传感设置，构建紧贴实测表面的紧凑3DGS表示，并避免体素网格或八叉树等离散场景划分。
method: PLS-GS对位置和颜色联合拟合分层高斯混合模型，形成连续自适应的LiDAR支架。每个可渲染3D高斯关联到一个GMM分量，并在该分量协方差诱导的局部表面坐标系中受约束；同时使用Mahalanobis support loss限制渲染高斯相对LiDAR表面的偏差。
result: 在五个大型室外场景中，PLS-GS使基元明显更接近LiDAR测量值，同时使用更少基元，模型更紧凑且渲染更快；在匹配容量下，其基元更贴近LiDAR测量值，并保持可比渲染质量。
conclusion: PLS-GS提出了一种概率LiDAR支架驱动的表面对齐3DGS表示，在紧凑性和几何一致性上优于图像及LiDAR初始化基线，代码已开源。

title: SHIN: Scalable Hierarchy for INcremental 3D Gaussian Splatting
abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) provides high-quality real-time novel-view synthesis, but deployment budgets vary across devices and network conditions. Most compact methods target one operating point, so another budget requires a separate representation. SHIN is a scalable 3DGS hierarchy with a reusable Base and additive enhancement layers, so each higher-quality operating point extends rather than replaces the decoded representation. Constructing this hierarchy requires deciding which Gaussians each stage adds and how much spherical-harmonic (SH) appearance each retains, because these choices remain fixed in later prefixes. SHIN derives one shared Gaussian order from multi-scale position-scale sensitivity and divides each stage budget between adding Gaussians and retaining SH bands using calibrated gradient-based scores per byte. Lightweight opacity updates adjust compositing while transmitted geometry and SH coefficients remain unchanged. Across three benchmarks, SHIN progressively improves one cumulative representation and achieves the best PSNR-size efficiency in every overlapping comparison with the multi-rate and progressive baselines.
tldr: SHIN提出可扩展3DGS层级，用共享高斯排序与逐字节评分分配增量层的高斯和SH波段，实现多预算累积式高质量渲染。
motivation: 3DGS虽能实时高质量新视角合成，但设备与网络条件下的部署预算各异；多数紧凑方法只针对单一工作点，换预算需另建表示。SHIN旨在用一套可复用层级支持多质量/尺寸预算。
method: SHIN由可复用Base与附加增强层组成，高层级扩展而非替换已解码表示；基于多尺度位置-尺度敏感性生成共享高斯排序，并用校准的逐字节梯度分数在各阶段预算中分配新增高斯与保留SH波段。轻量不透明度更新仅调整合成，传输的几何与SH系数保持不变。
result: 在三个基准上，SHIN对同一累积表示逐步提升质量，并在与多码率及渐进式基线的所有重叠比较中取得最佳PSNR-size效率；摘要未提供具体PSNR或尺寸数值。
conclusion: SHIN实现了可扩展的增量式3DGS表示，避免为每个预算单独训练/传输模型，为跨设备与网络条件的自适应3DGS部署提供了可行方案。

title: VAComp: View-Aware Full Projector Compensation
abstract: Full projector compensation adjusts a projector's input image to compensate for both geometric and photometric distortions introduced by the projection surface. Existing methods generally treat the viewing condition as a static camera viewpoint. When applied to a moving viewer, existing methods face two key challenges: (1) view-dependent methods require model retraining or recalibration to compensate for novel viewpoints; and (2) NeRF/GS-based view-agnostic methods use structure from motion (SfM) to calibrate the projector-camera systems (ProCams) with an unknown global scale, while view-aware tracking requires calibrating a camera oriented opposite to the projector, which introduces an additional calibration challenge. To address these challenges, we introduce VAComp, the first view-aware framework for full projector compensation for a moving viewer in a naked-eye setting. Using a projector, VAComp enables the viewer to perceive a virtual object that visually replaces the real object or to observe view-consistent modifications of the real object's appearance and material properties. To resolve the SfM scale ambiguity, we use metric calibration as a reference to recover the global scale; to calibrate the oppositely facing camera, we use two checkerboards, one facing the RGB camera and the other facing the depth camera. To balance compensation quality and runtime efficiency, we develop two non-iterative hybrid methods, VAComp-SD and VAComp-SI. Both combine 2D Gaussian-based view-conditioned geometric correction with learned photometric compensation, predicting each compensation image through a single forward pass without per-frame iterative optimization. Real-world experiments show that both methods achieve competitive compensation quality, with VAComp-SD enabling real-time updates and VAComp-SI operating at interactive rates. Project page: https://realkaizhou.github.io/VAComp/.
tldr: VAComp 提出首个面向移动观看者的视角感知全投影仪补偿框架，实现实时或交互式无迭代补偿。
motivation: 现有全投影仪补偿方法通常将观看条件视为静态相机视角，难以适用于移动观看者。移动场景下面临两类挑战：视角相关方法需为新视角重新训练或重标定；基于 NeRF/GS 的视角无关方法依赖 SfM 标定 ProCams，存在全局尺度未知问题，且视角感知跟踪需标定与投影仪朝向相反的相机，增加标定难度。
method: VAComp 使用投影仪实现裸眼移动观看下的视角感知全投影补偿。针对 SfM 尺度歧义，以度量标定作为参考恢复全局尺度；针对反向相机标定，使用分别面向 RGB 相机与深度相机的两块棋盘格。为兼顾质量与效率，提出两种非迭代混合方法 VAComp-SD 与 VAComp-SI，将基于 2D Gaussian 的视角条件几何校正与学习式光度补偿结合，通过单次前向传播预测每帧补偿图像，无需逐帧迭代优化。
result: 真实世界实验表明，VAComp-SD 与 VAComp-SI 均取得有竞争力的补偿质量；其中 VAComp-SD 支持实时更新，VAComp-SI 达到交互式运行速度。摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: VAComp 是首个面向移动观看者裸眼设置的全投影仪视角感知补偿框架，可使观看者感知替代真实物体的虚拟对象，或观察真实物体外观与材质属性的视角一致修改。其贡献包括恢复 SfM 全局尺度、标定反向相机，以及兼顾质量与效率的非迭代补偿方法，对增强现实与投影交互应用具有潜在影响。

title: Scaling Optimization-Oriented Hypernetworks for Implicit Neural Representations
abstract: We present a hypernetwork that generates the parameters of an implicit neural representation (INR) for a given signal in a single forward pass, without test-time optimization. Existing hypernetworks for this problem either ignore the chain-rule structure of the test-time optimization that produces an INR or, when they preserve it, instantiate the structure with MLPs whose parameter count grows quartically in target-network width. Our central contribution is to show that this parameter-count cost is structural to the MLP instantiation, not to the optimization-oriented principle of preserving chain-rule structure, and to resolve it by replacing the MLP body with attention. The resulting hypernetwork combines three design choices: an output-neuron-centric tokenization that aligns the token axis with each layer's output-neuron axis; an information-flow consistency rule that fixes the role of every cross-attention module from the representation its output should occupy; and a token-space iterative rollout that realizes the five quantities one optimization step on the target INR computes as five cross-attention modules with parameter count independent of target-network width. Across five 2D and 3D INR generation benchmarks, our method outperforms the state-of-the-art single-pass and optimization-oriented baselines; scales to target-network widths at which the MLP-based optimization-oriented paradigm exhausts GPU memory; and produces the highest result on NeRF generation without ground-truth INR weights supervision.
tldr: 用注意力替换MLP构建优化导向超网络，单次前向生成INR参数并突破宽度扩展瓶颈。
motivation: 现有面向隐式神经表示（INR）生成的超网络，要么忽略测试时优化产生INR的链式法则结构，要么在保留该结构时使用MLP实例化，导致参数量随目标网络宽度呈四次方增长。本文旨在证明这一参数量代价源于MLP实例化而非优化导向原则本身，并解决其扩展性问题。
method: 提出以注意力替换MLP主体的优化导向超网络，保留测试时优化的链式法则结构。具体包含三项设计：以输出神经元为中心的tokenization，使token轴与每层输出神经元轴对齐；信息流一致性规则，根据每个cross-attention模块输出应占据的表示来固定其角色；token空间迭代rollout，将目标INR一次优化步计算的五个量实现为五个cross-attention模块，且参数量与目标网络宽度无关。
result: 在五个2D和3D INR生成基准上，该方法优于最先进的单次前向与优化导向基线；可扩展到基于MLP的优化导向范式耗尽GPU内存的目标网络宽度；在无真实INR权重监督的NeRF生成任务上取得最佳结果。摘要未提供具体量化数值。
conclusion: 结果表明，优化导向超网络的参数量瓶颈是MLP实例化的结构性问题，用注意力替代可在保持链式法则结构的同时实现宽度扩展。该工作提升了单次前向INR参数生成的性能与可扩展性，并对NeRF等神经场生成具有潜在影响。

title: S2HAND: Accuracy-Preservation Trade-Offs for Hand Specialization in Whole-Body Pose Models
abstract: Unified whole-body pose estimators jointly predict body, face, and hand landmarks, but often degrade on small, blurred, or occluded hands. Attaching a standalone hand specialist introduces extra detection overhead, coordinate alignment, and wrist-stitching artifacts. We introduce S2HAND, a hand-specialized Sapiens2-5B framework that preserves the native 308-keypoint output interface. Specifically, S2HAND-MT adapts a lightweight 0.87M-parameter pose branch to route 40 finger heatmaps while strictly preserving the shared Transformer, auxiliary task heads, and the other 268 body, foot, and face heatmaps. S2HAND-Pose further fine-tunes three Fisher-selected Transformer blocks (267.13M parameters), trading exact preservation for stronger hand recovery: it lifts macro AUC from 57.83% to 65.73% across HInt TEST, COCO WholeBody VAL, and FreiHAND EVAL, and surpasses HInt-adapted Hand5/HRNet and stitched Hand5 systems on all five Native Pipeline benchmarks. On COCO, S2HAND-Pose improves hand AP by 12.89 points and body-plus-foot AP by 0.19 points. Across a 512-image multi-task audit, it maintains 99.60% foreground segmentation agreement with the public checkpoint, with quantified normal and pointmap drift. Its 2D coordinates also lower 3D mesh error in frozen Pose2Mesh transfer, while our optional TailGuard re-cropping module cuts S2HAND-MT's severe failure rate on NewDays from 13.45% to 10.43%. S2HAND thus resolves the whole-body hand bottleneck with either exact non-hand preservation (MT) or empirically audited trade-offs (Pose).
tldr: S2HAND在整体姿态模型中专门增强手部，兼顾非手部保持与手部恢复。
motivation: 统一整体姿态估计器联合预测身体、面部和手部关键点，但在小尺度、模糊或遮挡手部上性能下降；单独接入手部专家又会引入额外检测开销、坐标对齐和手腕拼接伪影。
method: 提出S2HAND框架，保留Sapiens2-5B原生308关键点输出接口：S2HAND-MT用0.87M参数轻量姿态分支路由40个手指热图并严格保留共享Transformer、辅助任务头及其他268个身体/脚/面部热图；S2HAND-Pose进一步微调三个Fisher选择的Transformer块（267.13M参数），以更强手部恢复换取非手部精确保持，并提供可选TailGuard重裁剪模块。
result: S2HAND-Pose将HInt TEST、COCO WholeBody VAL和FreiHAND EVAL上的macro AUC从57.83%提升至65.73%，在五个Native Pipeline基准上超过HInt适配的Hand5/HRNet和拼接Hand5系统；COCO上手部AP提升12.89点，身体加脚AP提升0.19点。512图多任务审计中与公开检查点保持99.60%前景分割一致，并量化了normal与pointmap漂移；冻结Pose2Mesh迁移中2D坐标降低3D网格误差，TailGuard将S2HAND-MT在NewDays上的严重失败率从13.45%降至10.43%。
conclusion: S2HAND通过MT的精确非手部保持或Pose的经验审计权衡，解决了整体姿态模型的手部瓶颈，并展示了在2D/3D任务中的可迁移收益与可控副作用。

title: RefineSplat: Reconstruction-Guided Object-Centric Gaussian Splatting for Open-Vocabulary Querying
abstract: Open-vocabulary 3D scene understanding aims to segment and retrieve arbitrary objects in 3D scenes using natural language queries. Most existing methods typically follow a splat-then-segment paradigm, where 3D Gaussian Splatting is first reconstructed and then augmented with labels or language features for subsequent segmentation. However, this pipeline often suffers from view inconsistency, ambiguous object boundaries, and weak object-level correspondence, especially in complex static and dynamic scenes. Building on our prior Segment-then-Splat framework, we present RefineSplat, a reconstruction-guided extension that retains its object-centric paradigm: it first tracks objects in 2D and then reconstructs each object with a dedicated set of 3D Gaussians, preserving explicit object-Gaussian correspondence for unified open-vocabulary segmentation and retrieval. To improve robustness, we further close the loop between 2D tracking and 3D reconstruction. Since off-the-shelf video trackers can produce unreliable masks that propagate errors into object reconstruction, we introduce a reconstruction-guided feedback mechanism that refines object tracking using rendered masks and multi-view consistency. Moreover, instead of assigning each object a single language embedding, we propose a viewpoint-aware embedding assignment strategy, where each object maintains multiple view-clustered embeddings to capture view-dependent semantic cues. We also introduce Blender-OVS, a synthetic benchmark of static and dynamic sequences with exact object meshes and point clouds, enabling direct evaluation of extracted geometry. Experiments on static and dynamic benchmarks show improved rendered-view segmentation and lower object-level Chamfer distances, with competitive scene reconstruction quality.
tldr: RefineSplat通过重建引导反馈优化对象跟踪，并用视角感知嵌入实现开放词汇3D分割与检索。
motivation: 现有开放词汇3D场景理解多采用先重建后分割的范式，易受视角不一致、对象边界模糊和对象级对应弱等问题影响，在复杂静态与动态场景中尤为明显。本文延续Segment-then-Splat的对象中心思路，旨在建立显式对象-Gaussian对应并提升跟踪与重建的鲁棒性。
method: RefineSplat先进行2D对象跟踪，再为每个对象重建专用3D Gaussians，从而保留显式对象-Gaussian对应以统一支持开放词汇分割与检索。方法引入重建引导反馈机制，利用渲染掩码和多视角一致性修正不可靠的跟踪掩码；同时为每个对象维护多个按视角聚类的语言嵌入以捕捉视角相关语义，并提出Blender-OVS静态/动态合成基准用于几何评估。
result: 在静态和动态基准上的实验表明，该方法提升了渲染视角分割效果，降低了对象级Chamfer距离，并保持有竞争力的场景重建质量。摘要未提供具体量化指标；Blender-OVS提供精确对象网格与点云，可用于直接评估提取几何。
conclusion: RefineSplat通过闭环连接2D跟踪与3D重建，增强了对象中心Gaussian表示在开放词汇分割和检索中的鲁棒性与几何一致性。其显式对象对应、重建引导跟踪修正和视角感知嵌入为复杂静态/动态3D场景理解提供了有效路线，并借助Blender-OVS推动几何层面的标准化评估。

title: ClearForm: Shared-Surface Gaussian Splatting for Transparent and Opaque Scenes
abstract: Transparent-interface reconstruction must recover glass surfaces even when most observed color comes from the scene behind them. We present ClearForm, a shared-planar-Gaussian method for jointly reconstructing transparent interfaces and the appearance seen through them. We identify and analyze the Geometry-Appearance Compositing Dilemma (GACD): when the same transparency-dependent alpha controls both color and geometry, revealing the background can weaken a transparent surface's contribution to geometric reconstruction. We derive its effect on plane-based depth estimation, identify a mechanism that can weaken geometric learning, and quantify the loss of interface support through controlled comparisons. To address this conflict, we develop geometry-preserving dual-opacity surface reconstruction. Shared planar Gaussians retain interface contributions in geometry compositing while modeling transmission and sparse reflection in RGB, supported by transparency-aware geometric constraints. To manage the different primitive-visibility requirements of these compositors, we introduce Dual-Evidence Lifecycle (DEL), which retains Gaussians supported by multi-view geometry or RGB reconstruction evidence. On 3D-FRONT-T, ClearForm achieves 27.05 mm Chamfer distance (CD) and 0.928 F1, compared with 59.18 mm CD for our PGSR reproduction and the reported 34 mm CD and 0.836 F1 for GLINT. On TransLab, it achieves 1.65 mm CD, 0.963 F1, and 40.14 dB PSNR. In matched ablations, dual-opacity compositing reduces CD from 59.25 to 27.09 mm, while DEL improves PSNR by 2.06 dB. Our project page is available at https://hajeongx.github.io/clearform/.
tldr: 提出共享平面高斯ClearForm，用双不透明度与DEL联合重建透明界面及透见场景。
motivation: 透明界面重建需在大部分观测颜色来自背后场景时仍恢复玻璃表面。作者指出Geometry-Appearance Compositing Dilemma（GACD）：同一透明度相关alpha同时控制颜色与几何，揭示背景会削弱透明表面对几何重建的贡献，并影响基于平面的深度估计。
method: ClearForm采用共享平面高斯联合重建透明界面与透见外观，提出几何保持的双不透明度表面重建：共享平面高斯在几何合成中保留界面贡献，在RGB中建模透射与稀疏反射，并加入透明度感知几何约束。为满足不同合成器对图元可见性的需求，引入Dual-Evidence Lifecycle（DEL），保留由多视角几何或RGB重建证据支持的Gaussian。
result: 在3D-FRONT-T上达到27.05 mm Chamfer距离和0.928 F1，优于PGSR复现的59.18 mm CD及GLINT报告的34 mm CD和0.836 F1；在TransLab上达到1.65 mm CD、0.963 F1和40.14 dB PSNR。匹配消融中，双不透明度合成将CD从59.25降至27.09 mm，DEL将PSNR提升2.06 dB。
conclusion: ClearForm通过共享平面高斯、双不透明度合成与DEL缓解GACD，实现透明与不透明场景的联合重建，并在多个数据集上显著优于基线。该方法为透明界面重建与透见外观建模提供了有效的几何保持方案，具有推动真实场景高斯重建的潜力。

title: Evaluating Anterior Cruciate Ligament Risk of Injury Using a Graph Convolutional Autoencoder
abstract: Current solutions for assessing the risk of anterior cruciate ligament (ACL) injury typically rely on expensive motion-capture labs that require substantial resource investment or subjective evaluations of specific athletic stress tests by experts. The Drop Vertical Jump (DVJ) and the Single Leg Hop (SLH) are two examples of such tests typically used to track progress in ACL rehabilitation. In this paper, we develop an unsupervised learning model that runs entirely on a smartphone for two tasks, based on an autoencoder architecture with multiple layers of graph convolutional networks, which utilizes pose estimation data to determine a person's injury risk status. Our model accurately predicts athletes at high risk of injury for both athletic stress tests, with average sensitivities and specificities of 78% and 78% for the DVJ, and 75% and 74% for the SLH. Our findings support the development of a widely accessible smartphone solution for real-time screening of ACL injury risk.
tldr: 提出一种可在智能手机运行的图卷积自编码器，利用姿态估计数据无监督评估ACL损伤风险。
motivation: 现有ACL损伤风险评估依赖昂贵且资源密集的动作捕捉实验室，或由专家对特定运动压力测试进行主观评价，难以广泛可及。
method: 作者构建了由多层图卷积网络组成的自编码器无监督模型，完全在智能手机上运行，并以姿态估计数据为输入，针对DVJ和SLH两项测试判断个体损伤风险状态。
result: 模型对DVJ的平均敏感度和特异度分别为78%和78%，对SLH分别为75%和74%，能较准确识别高风险运动员。
conclusion: 结果表明基于智能手机的ACL损伤风险实时筛查具有可行性，有望提供广泛可及、低成本的评估工具。

title: Direct Regression and Geometric Recovery for Event-based Spacecraft Pose Estimation
abstract: Event cameras offer high temporal resolution and dynamic range for uncooperative spacecraft pose estimation, but models trained on synthetic event streams must generalize to the noise, background activity, and contrast variation of physical sensors. We present a comparative systems study of two independently developed approaches to synthetic-to-real, event-based 6-DoF spacecraft pose estimation. The first is a modular pipeline that combines learned keypoint detection and unlabeled target-domain adaptation with geometry-based pose recovery and temporal smoothing. The second directly regresses translation and rotation from global and cropped event representations using an apparent-scale cue, physics-motivated synthetic corruptions, and feature-consistency regularization. We evaluate both systems under the same SPARK 2026 hidden-test protocol on the real-event split of SPADES, with predictions for all test frames. The results reveal a component-wise reversal concealed by the aggregate challenge score: direct regression reduces orientation error by 22.7% (1.1767 to 0.9101 rad) and obtains a 13.4% lower composite score, whereas the modular pipeline reduces relative translation error by 78.7% (0.1335 to 0.0285). Archived configurations and a qualitative failure case identify plausible explanations for these complementary error profiles, without isolating their causes. These findings motivate a testable hybrid design that combines direct orientation estimation with geometry-constrained translation recovery.
tldr: 对比两种事件相机航天器位姿估计系统，发现直接回归方向更准、模块化管线平移更准，并提出混合设计。
motivation: 解决合成事件流训练的模型在真实传感器噪声、背景活动和对比度变化下的泛化问题，并比较两类合成到真实6-DoF航天器位姿估计路线。
method: 第一种为模块化管线：学习关键点检测、无标签目标域自适应、几何位姿恢复与时间平滑；第二种从全局和裁剪事件表征直接回归平移与旋转，利用表观尺度线索、物理启发的合成损坏和特征一致性正则。
result: 在SPADES真实事件划分和SPARK 2026隐藏测试协议下，直接回归将姿态角误差降低22.7%（1.1767降至0.9101 rad）且综合分低13.4%；模块化管线将相对平移误差降低78.7%（0.1335降至0.0285）。
conclusion: 两种方法呈现被总榜分数掩盖的分量反转：方向估计利于直接回归、平移估计利于几何管线；由此提出结合直接方向估计与几何约束平移恢复的可测试混合设计，并指出失败案例仅提供可能解释而未隔离原因。

title: CRTrack-Cap: A New Benchmark for Cross-View Dense Video Object Captioning
abstract: Dense video object captioning (DVOC) localizes, tracks, and describes object trajectories within a video. Existing methods process each camera view independently, producing separate camera-local tracklets and captions for the same person across cameras. These outputs lack a unified description and leave complementary appearance evidence across views unused. We therefore formulate cross-view DVOC (CVDVOC), which associates these tracklets into scene-level global trajectories and generates one caption for each trajectory from synchronized views. To support this task, we construct CRTrack-Cap from CRTrack by auditing text-identity links and converting usable referring expressions into canonical captions. It retains 425 global trajectories and 838 local tracklets across 13 scenes, with canonical captions for 335 identities. We adapt CHOTA to the cross-view setting as CV-CHOTA to jointly evaluate tracking and caption quality. Our reference framework combines View-Exclusive Cross-Camera Association (VECA) for grouping tracklets with Conflict-Evidence Gating (CEG) for integrating caption evidence using its reliability and disagreement across views. Against three single-view methods adapted with MvMHAT for cross-view association, our framework achieves CV-CHOTA scores of 83.43 and 33.48 on the scene-disjoint in-domain and cross-domain tests, respectively. Together, CRTrack-Cap and our framework provide a benchmark and a strong baseline for describing the same person consistently across camera views.
tldr: 提出跨视角DVOC任务、CRTrack-Cap基准及VECA+CEG基线方法。
motivation: 现有DVOC方法逐视角独立处理，同一行人在不同相机下产生分离的局部轨迹与描述，缺乏统一表述且未利用跨视角互补外观证据。为此，论文定义跨视角DVOC（CVDVOC）任务，将局部轨迹关联为场景级全局轨迹并生成单一描述。
method: 构建CRTrack-Cap：从CRTrack审计文本-身份链接并将可用指代表达转为规范描述，保留425条全局轨迹、838条局部轨迹、13个场景及335个身份的规范描述；将CHOTA扩展为CV-CHOTA以联合评估跟踪与描述质量。参考框架用VECA进行跨相机轨迹分组，并用CEG依据跨视角可靠性与分歧融合描述证据。
result: 在场景不相交的域内与跨域测试中，所提框架的CV-CHOTA分别达到83.43和33.48，优于三种经MvMHAT适配跨视角关联的单视角方法。
conclusion: CRTrack-Cap与参考框架为跨相机一致描述同一行人提供了基准和强基线，推动跨视角DVOC研究。

title: MetricPose: Flexible 3D Human Pose Estimation with Depth and Geometric Cues
abstract: In this paper, we present a 3D human pose estimator that predicts metrically accurate human joint positions in the camera coordinate frame. This task requires recovering the configuration of the body joints, scale, and metric camera-local placement. In monocular images, body size and camera distance are coupled through perspective projection and therefore cannot be determined uniquely from image alone. This ambiguity can be reduced by combining three complementary sources of information: learned RGB priors, direct depth measurements, and geometric constraints (e.g., ground contact) from the environment. We extend a pretrained full-body estimator with optional metric depth and geometry-processing modules that improve camera-distance estimation and depth-guided body refinement while preserving RGB-only operation. The resulting unified model supports RGB, RGB-Ground, and RGB-D using shared learned parameters. Unlike pelvis-relative error, camera-local error also measures placement relative to the camera. Compared with the existing foundation model SAM 3D Body, our methods with RGB, RGB-Ground, and RGB-D modes reduce camera-local joint-position error by 12.16%, 31.00% and 54.61% respectively.
tldr: MetricPose 利用深度与几何线索提升单目相机坐标系下的度量三维人体姿态估计精度。
motivation: 单目图像中人体尺寸与相机距离经透视投影耦合，仅靠RGB无法唯一确定相机局部度量位置；需融合RGB先验、直接深度测量与环境几何约束来减少歧义。
method: 在预训练全身姿态估计器上扩展可选的度量深度和几何处理模块，改善相机距离估计与深度引导的身体细化，并支持RGB、RGB-Ground、RGB-D三种模式共享学习参数，同时保留纯RGB操作。
result: 与现有基础模型SAM 3D Body相比，RGB、RGB-Ground和RGB-D模式分别将相机局部关节位置误差降低12.16%、31.00%和54.61%。
conclusion: 结果表明融合深度与几何线索可有效缓解单目尺度-距离歧义，提高相机坐标系下的度量姿态精度，并提供灵活统一的多模态估计框架。

title: Flex-RSI: Benchmarking Recursive Self-Improvement of Frontier Agents
abstract: Frontier language models are increasingly deployed as agents, and how well an agent performs depends not only on its model but also on its harness: the prompts, tools, memory, and control loop through which the model acts. When an agent is applied to a new problem, a natural question is whether it can use the feedback of the task to improve the way it works, and not merely its answer. Most existing benchmarks keep the agent's harness fixed and score the solution it produces, or target large-scale model training. We introduce Flex-RSI, a benchmark for the recursive self-improvement of agents on vision and robotics tasks under a fixed budget. In each round, an executor improves the task solution, which is kept only if it scores higher on held-out validation data, and an improver then revises the harness, including the executor and itself. Every run starts from the same general-purpose harness, and the final solution is scored on hidden test data. Evaluating closed-source and open-weight models on tasks spanning perception, reasoning, robot action, 3D reconstruction, visual creation, and infrastructure, we find that self-improvement helps most when the agent builds its own solution, that feedback recording only success or failure holds back open-weight models, and that open-weight models fall furthest behind where outputs must pass strict checks of physical stability or exact correctness. Paired runs further show that editing the harness itself contributes to the gains.
tldr: 提出 Flex-RSI 基准，在固定预算下评估前沿智能体对自身执行框架的递归自我改进能力。
motivation: 现有基准通常固定智能体的执行框架（harness）并只评估其产出的解，或聚焦大规模模型训练，难以衡量智能体能否利用任务反馈改进自身工作方式而非仅改进答案。
method: Flex-RSI 采用多轮递归流程：执行器改进任务解，仅在留出验证集得分更高时保留；改进器随后修订执行框架，包括执行器与改进器自身。所有运行从同一通用框架开始，最终解在隐藏测试集上评分，任务覆盖感知、推理、机器人动作、3D重建、视觉创作与基础设施。
result: 对闭源与开放权重模型的评估显示：自我改进在智能体自行构建解时收益最大；仅记录成功/失败的反馈会限制开放权重模型；开放权重模型在需通过物理稳定性或精确正确性严格检查的输出上落后最多。配对运行进一步表明，修订执行框架本身对性能提升有贡献。
conclusion: 该工作提出了评估智能体递归自我改进执行框架的基准，证明框架编辑能带来实际收益，并揭示开放权重模型在严格物理与正确性约束下的短板。其结论可为智能体框架设计、反馈机制与评测体系提供参考。

title: EgoGeneralist: Unifying Egocentric Action-Video Tasks through Video-Native Modeling
abstract: Modern video models possess strong visual priors, yet do not natively represent human action in metric 3D space. We present EgoGeneralist, which adapts pretrained video generators to unify action-conditioned egocentric video generation, pose estimation, and joint action-video generation. Our role-adaptive action renderer provides video-native representations for multidirectional action-video learning, making metric motion usable as both a spatial control signal and a recoverable generation target. Cross-stream action-video coupling establishes close correspondence between metric motion and visual dynamics through lightweight adaptation while preserving the pretrained visual prior. Together, these designs establish a generalist framework spanning five action-video tasks. Despite adaptation only on controlled laboratory recordings, EgoGeneralist generalizes to diverse unseen scenes and interactions with effective action control and visual quality, bridging pretrained visual knowledge and metric 3D human motion.
tldr: EgoGeneralist将预训练视频生成器统一用于自我中心动作视频生成、姿态估计与联合生成。
motivation: 现有视频模型具有强视觉先验，但无法以视频原生方式在度量3D空间中表示人类动作。作者希望统一动作条件自我中心视频生成、姿态估计与联合动作-视频生成。
method: 提出角色自适应动作渲染器，为多向动作-视频学习提供视频原生表示，使度量运动既可作为空间控制信号，又可作为可恢复的生成目标。通过轻量适配的跨流动作-视频耦合，在保留预训练视觉先验的同时建立度量运动与视觉动态的紧密对应。
result: 该框架覆盖五类动作-视频任务；在仅用受控实验室录像适配的情况下，模型可泛化到多样未见场景与交互，并保持有效的动作控制与视觉质量。摘要未提供定量指标。
conclusion: 该工作构建了覆盖五类动作-视频任务的通用框架，连接预训练视觉知识与度量3D人体运动，为统一自我中心动作理解与生成提供了新路径。

title: MOMASPLAT: Dynamic Novel-View Demonstration Augmentation for Mobile Manipulation
abstract: Visuomotor policies trained through imitation learning are highly sensitive to changes in camera viewpoint. This is particularly problematic for mobile manipulation (MoMa), where robots rarely execute manipulation from the exact same base pose used during demonstration collection due to navigation uncertainty, localization drift, and environmental constraints. Recent approaches use novel-view synthesis (NVS) to augment demonstrations with unseen viewpoints, but they assume static scenes and therefore fail to re-render the manipulated object during the post-contact interaction phase, leaving the most critical parts of the demonstration unaugmented. We present MOMASPLAT, a novel-view demonstration augmentation framework for mobile manipulation that synthesizes full manipulation trajectories from unseen robot base poses, including dynamic object interactions. Our key insight is that standard MoMa data collection naturally provides the multiview observations needed to reconstruct both the static scene and the manipulated object in 3D. MOMASPLAT combines 3D Gaussian Splatting, feed-forward 3D foundation models, and kinematics-based action retargeting to separately reconstruct the scene and manipulated object, render them from novel viewpoints, and generate geometrically consistent synthetic demonstrations paired with transformed actions. We evaluate MOMASPLAT on five real-world mobile manipulation tasks involving both rigid and articulated objects across three scenes, and validate the fidelity of its synthesized demonstrations against ground truth in simulation. MOMASPLAT substantially improves robustness to unseen base poses, more than doubling the average success rate of the strongest baseline and maintaining non-trivial success at large base displacements where all baselines fail, while reducing the need for largescale real-world data collection.
tldr: MOMASPLAT通过动态新视角合成增强移动操作示范，显著提升未见基座位姿下的策略鲁棒性。
motivation: 视觉运动策略对相机视角变化高度敏感，而移动操作中导航不确定、定位漂移和环境约束使机器人难以在与示范采集完全相同的基座位姿下执行操作。现有基于新视角合成的示范增强方法假设场景静态，无法在接触后交互阶段重渲染被操作物体，导致最关键部分的示范未被增强。
method: MOMASPLAT利用移动操作数据采集天然提供的多视角观测，分别重建静态场景与被操作物体，并从新基座位姿合成包含动态物体交互的完整操作轨迹。方法结合3D Gaussian Splatting、前馈3D基础模型和基于运动学的动作重定向，从新视角渲染场景与物体，并生成几何一致的合成示范及其变换后的动作。
result: 在三个场景的五项真实移动操作任务（含刚体和铰接物体）上评估，并在仿真中验证合成示范相对真值的保真度。MOMASPLAT将最强基线的平均成功率提高一倍以上，在较大基座位移下仍保持可观成功率，而所有基线均失败。
conclusion: 结果表明，动态新视角示范增强能有效提升移动操作策略对未见基座位姿的鲁棒性，并减少大规模真实数据采集需求。其贡献在于将动态物体重建与动作重定向结合到示范增强流程中，为移动操作的数据高效泛化提供了新思路。

title: InstantHand: Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting for Animatable Hand Avatar Reconstruction from a Single Image
abstract: Hand avatar reconstruction typically relies on multi-view capture or per-subject optimization, limiting its scalability. We introduce InstantHand, a feed-forward framework that constructs an animatable 3D Gaussian hand avatar from a single image using off-the-shelf MANO, camera, and mask estimates, without test-time optimization. Image-averaged losses provide insufficient supervision for alpha leakage, which thickens thin finger contours. To address this issue, we propose a Soft Alpha Band regularizer that concentrates supervision on silhouette boundaries. Furthermore, colors regressed from image features can drift toward a learned prior even in observed regions. Our Reliability-gated Appearance Transfer preserves observed appearance by transferring source colors according to each Gaussian's rendering contribution, while completing unobserved regions using the learned prior conditioned on global source identity. InstantHand constructs an avatar in 2.84 seconds and renders at 161 FPS, matching per-subject-optimized baselines on InterHand2.6M and remaining competitive in zero-shot evaluation on HanCo.
tldr: InstantHand 从单张图像前馈重建可动画手部高斯化身，无需测试时优化。
motivation: 手部化身重建通常依赖多视角采集或逐受试者优化，限制了可扩展性。单图像前馈重建面临轮廓监督不足导致 alpha 泄漏、细手指变粗，以及外观颜色在观测区域仍向学习先验漂移的问题。
method: InstantHand 利用现成 MANO、相机与掩码估计，从单张图像前馈构建可动画 3D Gaussian 手部化身，无需测试时优化。提出 Soft Alpha Band 正则将监督集中在轮廓边界以抑制 alpha 泄漏；提出 Reliability-gated Appearance Transfer，按每个 Gaussian 的渲染贡献转移源颜色以保留观测外观，并以全局源身份为条件用学习先验补全未观测区域。
result: InstantHand 在 2.84 秒内构建化身并以 161 FPS 渲染，在 InterHand2.6M 上匹配逐受试者优化基线，在 HanCo 零样本评估中保持竞争力。
conclusion: 该方法实现了无需测试时优化的单图像可动画手部化身重建，并具备高效推理能力。Soft Alpha Band 正则与 Reliability-gated Appearance Transfer 分别缓解轮廓泄漏和外观漂移，为可扩展的手部化身创建提供了新思路。

title: Hierarchical Incremental Beta Splatting for Online Reconstruction
abstract: Online 3D Gaussian Splatting reconstructs a scene during capture: each keyframe spawns primitives once and refines them for only a few dozen iterations, leaving little chance to fix poor initialization or missing detail. Gaussians are also inherently soft, needing many overlaps for solid surfaces. We present Hierarchical Incremental Beta Splatting (HIBS), which brings beta kernels to incremental reconstruction. Their shape parameter interpolates between a soft, Gaussian-like profile and a flat-topped, near-opaque surfel, acting as a confidence dial for geometry. Our confidence-aware spawning uses geometric observability and multi-view depth agreement to initialize both opacity and shape, producing solid primitives where geometry is verifiable and soft, correctable primitives where it is not. As online densification, error-driven relocation recycles stale primitives into photometric-error hotspots. Bounded beta kernel support enables exact tile culling and faster rasterization, and a closed-form, shape-preserving merging formulation provides a level-of-detail (LOD) hierarchy for fast optimization and real-time rendering. On Mip-NeRF 360 in the on-the-fly protocol, HIBS improves PSNR by up to 0.8 dB while reducing optimization time by up to 40%. Project page: https://linus-franke.com/hibs/
tldr: HIBS将beta核引入在线增量重建，通过置信度初始化与LOD合并提升质量并加速优化。
motivation: 在线3D高斯泼溅在采集过程中重建场景，每个关键帧仅生成一次原语且只优化几十次，难以修正较差初始化或补充缺失细节；同时高斯原语偏软，需要大量重叠才能形成实体表面。
method: HIBS将beta核引入增量重建，其形状参数可在软高斯轮廓与近平顶不透明surfel之间插值，作为几何置信度调节。置信度感知生成利用几何可观测性和多视角深度一致性初始化不透明度与形状；误差驱动重定位将陈旧原语回收至光度误差热点，并通过有界支撑实现精确tile剔除、闭式保形合并构建LOD层次。
result: 在Mip-NeRF 360的on-the-fly协议下，HIBS将PSNR最高提升0.8 dB，同时将优化时间最多减少40%，并支持更快光栅化与实时渲染。
conclusion: HIBS为在线重建提供了可调软硬度的beta splatting表示与LOD层次，在提升重建质量的同时显著加速优化，具备实时渲染应用潜力。

title: How Far Can Untrained Neural Networks Go in Anomaly Detection? From Tables to Pixels
abstract: Anomaly detection (AD) is often framed as a representation-learning problem, where strong performance is expected to require learned features or AD-specific optimization. However, this view can overlook the intrinsic separability of anomalies from normal references, even in the absence of learned representations. We therefore investigate how far untrained neural networks can go in anomaly detection. To this end, we propose PRISM, a framework combining fixed random nonlinear features with normal-reference Mahalanobis scoring for tabular detection and dense visual localization. Across 47 tabular datasets in ADBench, PRISM-T achieves the highest mean AUROC (86.4%) and the second-highest mean AUPRC (65.9%) among the compared methods. On MVTec AD and VisA, covering 27 visual categories, PRISM-V achieves mean image-level and pixel-level AUROCs of 90.4% and 96.4%, respectively. Notably, both models achieve these results without neural weight optimization or pretrained representations. A theoretical analysis further characterizes how nonlinear transformations affect the mean and covariance contributions to the Mahalanobis score gap, while empirical analyses examine the resulting score separability. These findings establish PRISM as both a competitive anomaly detector and a prior-to-learning baseline for assessing the added value of learned representations in anomaly detection.
tldr: PRISM用固定随机非线性特征与正态参考马氏评分，在无训练和无预训练表征下实现表格与图像异常检测。
motivation: 异常检测常被视为表征学习问题，并默认强性能依赖学习特征或面向异常检测的专门优化，这可能忽视异常相对正常参考本身的可分性。作者因此研究无训练神经网络在异常检测中能达到什么程度。
method: 提出PRISM框架，将固定的随机非线性特征与基于正常参考的马氏距离评分结合；PRISM-T用于表格异常检测，PRISM-V用于密集视觉定位。整个方法不进行神经权重优化，也不使用预训练表征，并从理论上分析非线性变换如何影响马氏评分差距中的均值与协方差贡献。
result: 在ADBench的47个表格数据集上，PRISM-T取得最高平均AUROC 86.4%和次高平均AUPRC 65.9%；在覆盖27个类别的MVTec AD与VisA上，PRISM-V取得平均图像级和像素级AUROC 90.4%与96.4%。
conclusion: 结果表明，无需学习权重或预训练表征的PRISM仍是有竞争力的异常检测器，同时可作为“学习之前”的基线，用于评估学习表征在异常检测中的增益，并揭示异常与正常参考之间的内在可分性。

title: Rotation Is Token-Blind: A Structural Criterion for Post-Training Quantization of Feed-Forward Geometry Transformers
abstract: Feed-forward 3D models use Transformers to predict camera poses, depth, and structure in one pass, avoiding iterative multi-view optimization. Long sequences and deep attention incur high compute and memory costs, motivating Post-Training Quantization (PTQ) for deployment. Existing PTQ methods mainly suppress channel-wise outliers by smoothing or orthogonal rotation. Geometry Transformers introduce a different challenge: heterogeneous token types share one activation quantization grid. A few special tokens may exert high leverage over global outputs and be updated by only a subset of blocks. Token-blind transforms, which apply the same transformation to every token, reduce overall quantization error but cannot remove differentiated degradation across token types. We propose QMapAnything, a structure-aware PTQ framework. We cast floating-point-preserving rotation and smoothing as a token-blind reparameterization group, and prove that they yield common-mode gains while leaving relative token SNR unchanged. We introduce a statistic $Γ$ that combines a special token's quantization disadvantage and output leverage to predict whether differentiated bias correction is needed beyond rotation. Experiments on geometric benchmarks show that W4A8 closely matches full-precision performance. Under W8A8, peak memory falls by $2.2$--$3.1\times$ versus FP32, with up to $3.1\times$ speedup on real hardware. These results provide a principled and efficient approach to deploying feed-forward 3D reconstruction models in resource-constrained edges.
tldr: 提出结构感知PTQ框架QMapAnything，用Γ统计量判断几何Transformer是否需要差异化偏差校正。
motivation: 前馈式3D模型用Transformer一次预测相机位姿、深度与结构，但长序列和深层注意力带来高计算与内存开销，需要PTQ以便部署。现有PTQ主要通过平滑或正交旋转抑制通道级离群值，而几何Transformer中异构token类型共享同一激活量化网格，少数特殊token对全局输出影响大且仅由部分模块更新，token-blind变换无法消除不同token类型间的差异化退化。
method: 提出结构感知PTQ框架QMapAnything，将保浮点旋转和平滑建模为token-blind重参数化群，并证明其只带来共模增益而不会改变相对token信噪比。进一步引入统计量Γ，结合特殊token的量化劣势与输出杠杆，预测在旋转之外是否需要差异化偏差校正。
result: 在几何基准上，W4A8量化性能与全精度接近；W8A8下峰值内存相比FP32降低2.2–3.1倍，在真实硬件上最高取得3.1倍加速。
conclusion: 结果表明该方法是部署前馈式3D重建模型到资源受限边缘设备的原则性且高效方案，为几何Transformer的PTQ提供了结构感知的新准则。

title: EDGAR: Efficient Diffusion-Driven Gaussian Avatar Refinement via Synthetic Failure
abstract: Recent advances in Gaussian splatting have enabled efficient and photorealistic head avatar reconstruction, yet monocular video-based or image-based methods still suffer from under-constrained geometry and texture, leading to artifacts such as blurring, stretching, and temporal instability. We present EDGAR (Efficient Diffusion-Driven Gaussian Avatar Refinement), a conditional diffusion framework designed to enhance the quality of Gaussian avatars by correcting artifacts while preserving identity fidelity. To train EDGAR, we construct EDGAR-SET, a hybrid triplet dataset composed of real-captured and synthetic-rendered samples, which simulates realistic Gaussian avatar failure cases by pairing degraded renderings with ground-truth and reference images. EDGAR refines degraded frames through a fusion block that injects identity features extracted by the self-supervised Sapiens model into a one-step diffusion backbone, enabling effective artifact removal without sacrificing efficiency. Our EDGAR model incorporates a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture to address diverse degradation types and severity levels.
